definition.en: The Rainbow Revolution refers to the integrated development of the Indian agriculture sector through the simultaneous growth of various sub-sectors like crops, horticulture, fisheries, and livestock.
definition.hi: The Rainbow Revolution refers to the integrated development of the Indian agriculture sector through the simultaneous growth of various sub-sectors like crops, horticulture, fisheries, and livestock.

importanceInUpsc.en: This topic is crucial for UPSC GS-3 as it highlights the shift from food security to nutritional security and sustainable agricultural practices. Understanding this framework helps in analyzing government policies and the diversification of the rural economy.
